llm.summary: This is a coherent real-estate skill kit, but its generator can write generated skill files outside the chosen output folder when given a crafted config.

dimensions.detail: render.py builds the output directory from configuration-derived manifest["name"] without validating path components, so a crafted brand slug/domain can redirect writes outside the requested output directory.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The installer copies a user-supplied generated skill directory into common agent skill folders and records a SHA-256 hash; this is persistent but disclosed and expected for skill installation.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Some activation text and generated trigger keywords are broad, and several templates include sales conversion guidance, but these are disclosed and aligned with the real-estate sales and marketing purpose.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Because the renderer writes SKILL.md and manifest.json, the path traversal flaw could overwrite or plant persistent agent skill instructions in another writable skill directory if the user runs it on an untrusted config.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The artifacts consistently describe a real-estate AI skill repository with calculators, sales SOPs, and templates for generating branded real-estate advisor skills.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install the packaged skills only if you are comfortable with real-estate sales and lead-conversion behavior. Do not run render.py on YAML configs from untrusted sources until generated names are restricted to safe characters and the final output path is checked for containment; inspect generated SKILL.md before installing it into an agent.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: Verified broad activation language in the root skill, examples, and archetype templates; this is a routing and over-activation risk, but it does not add hidden tool, credential, or system authority.
[T01] expected: Verified the content-marketing template requires a configured CTA on generated marketing content; this is disclosed within an acquisition/marketing module, though users should ensure it is not applied to neutral informational outputs.
[T01] unexpected: Verified the progress-broadcast template forces a visit/referral prompt onto progress reports; this is promotional output creep, but limited to response content and not evidence of system instruction hijacking or malware.
[T09] unexpected: Confirmed render.py validates only the --out root and then joins it with unvalidated manifest["name"] before creating directories and writing SKILL.md and manifest.json; this supports Review due to unintended file overwrite risk.
